levels.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: Opens «قال وحدثنا»: the first narrator is not named before «قال», so the chain begins at Abd Allah b. Abd al-Rahman. This is a second chain after the matn (the matn itself is not in the text), and it is the route to the saying.

«وروى مالك ... عن الزهري، عن سالم» and the Tirmidhi remarks («الصحيح حديث الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه») name other transmitters for the same saying, so they are variant groups (rule 4). The father in the last remark is named only by relation.
«بهذا الحديث» points to the matn rather than to a chain, so it is not written as a back-reference.
